limitations: Prometheus counters and histograms are process-lifetime signals; a target monitoring backend must persist and aggregate them across restarts.
Generation orphan counters include only objects known at stale-write fencing time and do not replace a complete RustFS inventory and reference scan.
No target intranet deployment, production traffic, manual browser UAT, remote CI or real rollback drill was executed in this gate.
G6 still requires target backfill remaining/gap/mismatch zero, at least 24 hours and 100 Current Analysis promotions, strict/read cutover and two release periods of rollback observation.
The default Phase 0 aggregate is PARTIAL because four explicit manual lanes were skipped; it is not Phase 0 gate eligible and does not prove remote CI.
The static deploy check did not inspect deployment-owned runtime environment files and did not start containers.
